SELECT /*selectMasterMpSoOrderStandbyList*/ A.BUYER , A.PR_NO , A.REF_NO , (SELECT to_char(MAX(PASSLN.PASS_DATE),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') FROM ICOMTRGW TRGW , ICOGDOCU DOCU , ICOGPASSLN PASSLN WHERE TRGW.COM_CODE = A.BUYER AND TRGW.KEY_1 = A.REF_NO AND TRGW.COM_CODE = DOCU.COMPANY AND TRGW.TARGET = DOCU.DOCU_NO AND DOCU.COMPANY = PASSLN.COMPANY AND DOCU.DOCU_NO = PASSLN.DOCU_NO AND CUR_ORDER_NO = PASSLN.ORDER_NO AND PASSLN.PASS_TP = '1' ) PASS_DATE , E.PR_SUBJECT , RTRIM( MAX( DECODE(B.AGENT,A.AGENT,'' ,NULL ,'계약서없음 |' ,'공급사오류 |') ) ||MAX( DECODE(B.UNIT_PRICE,A.TARGET_PRICE,'' ,NULL ,'계약서없음 |' ,'판매단가오류 |') ) ||MAX( DECODE(B.LIST_PRICE,A.LIST_PRICE,'' ,NULL ,'계약서없음 |' ,'매입단가오류 |') ) , '|' ) AS ERROR_CTNT , C.COM_NAME_LOC AS BUYER_NM , F.DEPT_NAME AS PURCH_DEPT , D.USER_NAME_LOC AS PURCHASER , E.CHANGE_DATE FROM ICOMPRDT A , ICOMCQDT B , ICOMCMPY C , ICOMLUSR D , ICOMPRHD E , (SELECT COMPANY_CODE , TEXT1 DEPT_NAME , CODE DEPT_CODE FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE='C001' ) F WHERE 1=1 AND (A.BUYER,A.REF_NO) IN ( SELECT BUYER,LEGACY_NO FROM IF_PROGRESS WHERE REMARK = 'BUDGET' AND GUBUN = 'XX' AND IF_FLAG NOT IN ('Y','D','C','Z') ) AND A.BYIT_COMORG_CODE = B.BUYER(+) AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = B.BUYER_ITEM_NO(+) AND A.CONTRACT_NO = B.CONTRACT_NO(+) AND A.CONTRACT_SEQ= B.CONTRACT_SEQ(+) AND A.BUYER = C.COM_CODE(+) AND A.PURCHASER_ID = D.USER_ID(+) AND A.BUYER = E.BUYER(+) AND A.PR_NO = E.PR_NO(+) AND A.PURCHASER_DEPT = F.DEPT_CODE(+) AND A.BUYER = F.COMPANY_CODE(+) AND B.STATUS(+) ^= 'D'
AND A.BUYER = #{st_buyer_code}
AND A.PR_NO like #{st_pr_no} || '%'
AND A.REF_NO like #{st_ref_no} || '%'
GROUP BY A.BUYER, A.PR_NO,A.REF_NO , E.PR_SUBJECT , C.COM_NAME_LOC , F.DEPT_NAME , D.USER_NAME_LOC , E.CHANGE_DATE ORDER BY A.BUYER, A.PR_NO,A.REF_NO
mapper.update: INSERT INTO KEPQTDT ( BUYER, QUOTATION_NO, QUOTATION_SEQ, REVISION, AGENT, AGENT_REVISION, STATUS, BUYER_ITEM_NO, DESCRIPTION, SPECIFICATION, UNIT_MEASURE, MAKER_NAME, ORIGIN_NAME, ATOS_DATE, ATOS_END_DATE, ATOS_END_TIME, ITEM_QTY, IMAGE_KEY, DSS_FLAG, DSS_CHOICE ) ( SELECT #{BUYER}, /* 1 : BUYER */ #{QUOTATION_NO}, /* 2 : QUOTATION_NO */ #{QUOTATION_SEQ}, /* 3 : QUOTATION_SEQ */ #{REVISION}, /* 4 : REVISION */ #{AGENT}, /* 5 : AGENT */ #{AGENT_REVISION}, /* 6 : AGENT_REVISION */ 'C', BUYER_ITEM_NO, DESCRIPTION, SPECIFICATION, UNIT_MEASURE, MAKER_NAME, ORIGIN_CODE, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD')AS ATOS_DATE, #{ATOS_END_DATE}, /* 7 : ATOS_END_DATE */ #{ATOS_END_TIME}, /* 8 : ATOS_END_TIME */ ITEM_QTY, IMAGE_KEY, #{DSS_FLAG}, /* 9 : DSS_FLAG if(chk_str[1].equals("A") || chk_str[1].equals("B") || chk_str[1].equals("C")|| chk_str[1].equals("S")) : Y , 기타 : N */ #{DSS_CHOICE} /* 10 : DSS_CHOICE */ FROM KEPRQDT WHERE BUYER=#{BUYER} /* 11 : BUYER */ AND QUOTATION_NO=#{QUOTATION_NO} /* 12 : QUOTATION_NO */ AND QUOTATION_SEQ=#{QUOTATION_SEQ} /* 13 : QUOTATION_SEQ */ AND REVISION=#{REVISION} /* 14 : REVISION */ AND RECV_FLAG <> 'GD' AND STATUS IN ('C','R') )

UPDATE KEPRQDT SET RECV_FLAG = 'GD' , CANCEL_USER_ID = #{USR_ID} /*CANCEL_USER_ID*/ , CANCEL_DATE = SYSDATE , CANCEL_REMARK = #{CANCEL_REMARK} /*CANCEL_REMARK*/ WHERE BUYER = #{BUYER} /*BUYER*/ AND QUOTATION_NO = #{QUOTATION_NO} /*QUOTATION_NO*/ AND QUOTATION_SEQ = #{QUOTATION_SEQ} /*QUOTATION_SEQ*/ AND REVISION = #{REVISION} /*REVISION*/ AND STATUS IN ('C','R')
